description: This source file implements a translation memory management system, including data structures for translation entries, functions for loading, retrieving, storing, and saving translation data, primarily stored in JSON format and managed via files.

classes.name: TMEntry
classes.description: Struct representing a translation memory entry with fields for caching, source, text, translation, provider, model, languages, and update timestamp.

classes.name: TranslationMemory
classes.description: Class managing a collection of translation memory entries, providing methods to load from file, retrieve, add, and save entries.

methods.name: LoadTranslationMemory
methods.description: Loads translation memory entries from a specified JSON lines file, returning a TranslationMemory instance.

methods.name: TranslationMemory.Get
methods.description: Retrieves a translated entry by cache key if it exists and is translated.

methods.name: TranslationMemory.Put
methods.description: Adds or updates an entry in the translation memory based on its cache key.

methods.name: TranslationMemory.Save
methods.description: Saves all translation entries back to the file in sorted JSON lines format.
